item.title: A medieval parsonage that's a 'fantasy mash-up of architectural styles', just down the road from a swish Somerset hotspot
item.description: The Grade I-listed Tintinhull Court is a breathtaking home that straddles the eras.

item.title: 'The Taylor Swift effect? We've never experienced anything like it': Jeweller Cece Fein-Hughes' consuming passions
item.description: Cece Jewellery's signature signet rings are beloved by the famous and fabulous — including Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Taylor Swift. Lotte Brundle meets the woman behind the jewellery.

item.title: ‘Re-using gemstones and gold pays in so many ways, turning "something old" into "something new" again’
item.description: Approximately 40% of all UK engagements happen between November and Valentine's Day, but choosing what to propose with can be a minefield. Why not look at what's hiding in the family jewellery box, says Jessica Diamond.

item.title: Ranking Agatha Christie’s murders from least to most likely
item.description: Have you been watching Netflix's 'Seven Dials' and wondering just how likely that murder really is? Laura Kay ranks ten of the Queen of Crime's best offings.

item.title: 'The Shakespeare of architects... he has yet had no equal in this country': Sir John Vanbrugh and the legacy of Blenheim Palace
item.description: To mark the tercentenary of Sir John Vanbrugh’s death, Charles Saumarez Smith considers the changing reactions to one of his greatest creations, Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire. Photographs by Will Pryce for Country Life.

item.title: 'Attractive people doing attractive things in attractive places': Slim Aarons's photographs of Cortina d’Ampezzo resurface ahead of the Winter Olympics
item.description: The Winter Olympics are nearly upon us. To celebrate we're taking a look back at legendary photographer Slim Aarons's photographs of Cortina d'Ampezzo which is hosting the Games for the second time.

item.title: 17 charming rural hideaways, from under £600,000 to £9.5 million, as seen in Country Life
item.description: Our look at some of the best homes to come to market via Country Life this week includes a charming farmhouse with stables and a home in a breathtaking spot on the South Downs.

item.title: The dog that saved Disney and once ran with horses: A spotted history of the Dalmatian
item.description: Famous for their spots and screen career, the Dalmatian has always looked at home beside beautiful things, but this is no decorative breed. Behind the spots lies a clever, athletic dog with a long working heritage, a strong will and serious stamina.

item.title: Audi S e-tron GT: Is this the EV that will save us from a dull and silent future?
item.description: She is a pretty car, but is she a good car?

item.title: The world’s heaviest flying bird flaps on to pastures new but remains endangered, says expert
item.description: You might think it a great time for the great bustards, who have been found breeding in a new location, but there is a wider problem facing the UK’s ‘big bird’, an expert says.
